user.title: User
user.description: Stores individual explorer profile data, including identity and mission enrollment details.

photoURL.description: URL to the explorer's visual identification.

enrolledMissions.description: List of active mission protocols the explorer is enrolled in.

rank.description: The current archival rank of the explorer (e.g., Novice, Commander).

EarthInsight.title: EarthInsight
EarthInsight.description: Provides up-to-date or historical data and insights about Earth's atmospheric conditions, water levels, oxygen, and temperature.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EarthInsight entity.

recordedAt.description: The date and time when this Earth insight data was recorded.

atmosphereDescription.description: A general description of Earth's atmospheric composition and conditions.

waterLevel.description: Global average water levels or a significant metric (e.g., sea level rise in mm).

oxygenLevelPercentage.description: Percentage of oxygen in Earth's atmosphere.

averageTemperatureCelsius.description: Global average surface temperature of Earth in Celsius.

Planet.title: Planet
Planet.description: Represents a celestial body classified as a planet, storing key astronomical and physical characteristics for exploration.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Planet entity.

name.description: The common name of the planet.

distanceFromSunAu.description: Average distance of the planet from the Sun in Astronomical Units (AU).

gravityMetersPerSecondSquared.description: Surface gravity of the planet in meters per second squared (m/s²).

atmosphereDescription.description: A detailed description of the planet's atmospheric composition and conditions, if any.

moonsCount.description: The number of natural satellites (moons) orbiting the planet.

orbitalPeriodDays.description: The time it takes for the planet to complete one orbit around its star, in Earth days.

rotationalPeriodHours.description: The time it takes for the planet to complete one rotation on its axis, in Earth hours.

imageUrl.description: URL to an illustrative image of the planet.

AstronomyPicture.title: AstronomyPicture
AstronomyPicture.description: Stores details for an astronomy picture of the day, typically fetched from a service like NASA APOD.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AstronomyPicture entity. Often derived from the date or a UUID.

date.description: The calendar date for which the astronomy picture was featured (e.g., YYYY-MM-DD).

title.description: The title provided for the astronomy picture.

explanation.description: A detailed explanation or description of the image content.

imageUrl.description: The URL to the standard resolution image of the day.

hdImageUrl.description: The URL to the high-definition version of the image, if available.

copyright.description: The copyright holder of the image, if specified.
